verdict.rationale: Check's own docs say it handles "the production and filing of tax forms" and provides employee and contractor tax documents. This points to first-party generation of worker tax forms. However, the evidence never names W-2s or 1099s, and it does not describe year-end automation or delivery to workers. Missing for 10: explicit W-2/1099 generation, documented automatic year-end runs, documented distribution of forms to workers, independent or hands-on corroboration.
